body.message:
Good Morning and Apologies for the delay in our response.

We would like to inform you that all of our apartments are located in Business Bay, Downtown Dubai, City Walk, and JVC. Unfortunately, we do not have any properties located near the beach or the sea.

However, if any of these locations work for you, please let us know your preferred dates and length of stay, and we will be happy to check the availability and provide you with suitable options.
